summary: Anthropic announced a themed grant call within its AI for Science program, offering up to $50,000 in Claude API credits over six months to researchers and early-stage biotechs working on rare genetic disease research and drug development.

practices.reason: One example grant project asks applicants to build rare-disease task evaluations including an honest accounting of failure modes, which is a transferable measurement idea but only an example, not a method the lab has run itself.
practices.quote: Build evaluations that measure how well models handle rare disease tasks—such as revealing candidate mechanisms for variants of unknown significance, phenotype-to-disease matching, and mechanism prediction—including an honest accounting of where they fail.
